title: Ohio Police Pursuit Ends in Wild Rollover Crash
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Butler County, Ohio — On May 29, 2025, at around 6 p.m., Ohio State Highway Patrol troopers were checking speeds on I-75 in Franklin Township when the driver of a GMC Envoy, later identified as Jennifer Wilson, was clocked going 82 mph in a 65 mph zone. When troopers initiated a stop, Wilson allegedly refused to comply, continuing for several minutes before veering off the road. In an apparent attempt to regain control, she overcorrected, causing her SUV to roll several times before coming to rest in the median. As first responders made their way to the scene, a passing nurse stopped to render aid. Wilson sustained minor injuries and was transported to a nearby hospital before being booked into jail. According to OSHP, she now faces multiple charges including operating a vehicle under the influence (OVI), failure to comply with a lawful order, and losing control of her vehicle. Investigators also linked her to a hit-and-run incident reported earlier that day in Montgomery County.
